board.description: The board to page through. Omitted, both are served, each sliced by the same `offset` and `limit`; named, the other one comes back empty.

edition.description: The edition to read, by its identifier (an `eventName` from `editions`). Defaults to the newest edition recorded.

max.description: Highest value kept on the `range` column, inclusive.

min.description: Lowest value kept on the `range` column, inclusive.

offset.description: Rows to skip on each board, after searching and ordering (default 0). The whole board is reachable, not only its first rows.

order.description: Direction of `sort` (default `desc`). Rows with no figure on the sorted column come last either way.

q.description: Case-insensitive search: a player's nickname, or a clan's tag or name. Rows keep their real place.

range.description: The column `min` and `max` bound. A row with no figure on it (a 24h move before the captures reach back a day) is left out.

sort.description: The column the boards are ordered on (default `fame-points`, the board's own order). `gain` and `move` are the last 24 hours.
